baseline: Three.js 0.182.0 (MIT), GSR 6.1.0-1 (GPL-3.0-only), existing Python helper and region backend; no new dependency.

coverage.reason: No controls or library layout changes.
Replay coverage resets when the native recording region changes; existing catalog clips remain.
Existing app identity, recorder ownership and capture permissions remain unchanged.
No network protocol or game authority changes.
Three.js viewport and GSR region must follow window dimensions.
No input or accessibility semantics change.
Production frame orchestration and helper timer regressions reproduce stale dimensions.
Use the existing Three.js dimensions comparison before rendering.

behavior.behavior: Compare current display dimensions with the applied render dimensions and update only when changed. The same comparison detects a stale fixed recorder rectangle.
edge_states: fullscreen without a delivered resize event
behavior.do_not_copy: Keep existing pixel ratio cap and fixed viewport ownership; do not copy demo scene or add dependencies.

platform.requirement: GSR control supports save and stop but no changing the capture rectangle; drain current saves before restarting replay. Region and output limit semantics also verified in installed 6.1.0 manual.

proof: npx vitest run --config vitest.client.config.ts test/client/sessionResources.test.ts reproduces and verifies preparation resize and first fullscreen frame.
node --test test/scripts/highlightsService.test.mjs verifies geometry changes, in-flight save isolation and coverage reset.

selection: Synchronize viewport before rendering, including static title frames. Restart owned replay on changed app bounds after current saves finish, with fresh coverage and explicit missed markers for discarded unfinished intervals.
